missions.title: Independence Day crypto freedom post
missions.description: Post connecting economic freedom to the crypto tax fight. Use any platform — X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook.
missions.script: This Independence Day, Illinois is imposing the most punitive digital asset tax in the country. SB 3019 takes effect Jan 1, 2027 — taxing community crypto events, educational workshops, and DAO-funded public goods. Support HB 5798 to repeal. #RepealDATA #CryptoFreedom

missions.title: Email blast to all 13 Democratic offices
missions.description: Send a personalized email to all 13 Democratic representatives who may be persuadable. Use the template below and customize the [BRACKETS].
missions.template:
Subject: Constituent Request — Support HB 5798 (Repeal Digital Asset Tax)

Dear Representative [NAME],

My name is [YOUR NAME] and I am a constituent in [YOUR CITY/NEIGHBORHOOD]. I am writing to ask you to support HB 5798, which would repeal the Digital Asset Tax enacted in SB 3019.

This tax, which takes effect January 1, 2027, is the most punitive digital asset tax in the country. It will:
- Drive blockchain innovators and jobs out of Illinois
- Punish community builders who organize free educational events
- Make Illinois uncompetitive with every neighboring state

[PERSONAL PARAGRAPH — Why this matters to you specifically]

I respectfully ask that you co-sponsor or publicly support HB 5798. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss this further with you or your staff.

Thank you for your time and service.

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR ADDRESS]
[YOUR PHONE]

missions.title: Week 1 recap post
missions.description: Share your experience making calls this week. Normalize the activity for others watching.
missions.script: Just finished my first week calling Illinois reps about the Digital Asset Tax (SB 3019). Made calls to all 13 Democratic offices. Most staffers were polite and took notes. If you're in IL, it takes 2 minutes. HB 5798 would repeal it. Scripts available — DM me. #RepealDATA

missions.title: First office visit — most receptive office from Week 1
missions.description: Visit the district office of whichever representative's staff was most receptive during your calls. Bring a one-page leave-behind with key facts about the DATA tax.
tips: Call ahead to schedule a 10-minute meeting with district staff
Dress business casual — you want to look like a serious constituent
Bring a printed one-pager: what SB 3019 does, what HB 5798 fixes, who you are
Ask for the staffer's name and direct email for follow-up
If the rep is in, great — but staff meetings count too
Be brief, be respectful, be memorable. Personal stories > policy wonking.

missions.title: Contact Illinois Blockchain Association
missions.description: Reach out to the Illinois Blockchain Association to coordinate efforts. They may already have lobbying infrastructure we can plug into.

missions.title: Second office visit
missions.description: Visit your second-most-receptive office. If possible, bring a fellow constituent for a stronger impression.
tips: Two constituents are twice as powerful as one
Coordinate with someone from the same district if possible
Mention that you called last week and wanted to follow up in person
Ask specifically: 'Has the Representative taken a position on HB 5798?'
Leave your contact info for follow-up

missions.title: Reach out to OnionDAO organizer
missions.description: Contact the OnionDAO organizer to coordinate testimony and community impact stories. They have firsthand experience of what the tax threatens.

missions.title: Third office visit
missions.description: Final visit of the week. Target a legislator whose staff was noncommittal — your persistence demonstrates serious constituent concern.
tips: If previous visits went well, try a harder target
Frame it as: 'I visited two other offices this week — this issue matters to many of us'
Ask for a formal written response to your constituent request

missions.title: Post about your office visits
missions.description: Share (tastefully) that you're visiting legislative offices. This normalizes civic engagement and recruits others.
missions.script: Visited my third Illinois state rep office this week about the Digital Asset Tax (SB 3019). Staff are listening. They track constituent contacts — every call and visit gets logged. If you're in IL, your voice matters more than you think. #RepealDATA

missions.title: Draft an op-ed
missions.description: Write a 500-700 word op-ed for local media about why Illinois should repeal the DATA tax. Focus on community impact, not crypto ideology. Target: Chicago Sun-Times, Chicago Tribune, Crain's Chicago Business, or your local paper.

missions.title: Research district mapping
missions.description: Use the Illinois General Assembly website to map which of the 13 target districts have the most crypto/tech activity. Identify co-working spaces, meetup groups, and tech companies in those districts.

missions.title: Start coalition group chat
missions.description: Create a Signal, Telegram, or Discord group for campaign coordination. Invite everyone you've connected with so far — other callers, the OnionDAO organizer, IL Blockchain Association contacts.

missions.title: Submit op-ed
missions.description: Submit your drafted op-ed to at least one publication. Chicago Sun-Times letters: letters@suntimes.com. Tribune: ctc-TribLetter@tribpub.com. Crain's: opinions@chicagobusiness.com.

missions.title: Update whip sheet
missions.description: Review all contacts from Weeks 1-2. Update the whip sheet with each legislator's current stance: supportive, leaning yes, noncommittal, leaning no, opposed, or unknown.

missions.title: Week 2 recap and recruit
missions.description: Share what you accomplished in two weeks. Explicitly ask others to join.
missions.script: Two weeks of calling and visiting Illinois reps about repealing the Digital Asset Tax. 13 offices contacted. 3 in-person visits. Coalition growing. We have until January to stop this. If you're in IL and care about crypto/community events, join us. DM for scripts and resources. #RepealDATA

missions.title: Share call scripts with 5+ people
missions.description: Send the call scripts and phone numbers to at least 5 people who might be willing to make calls. Personal ask > mass blast. Text or DM individually.

missions.title: Mobilization post
missions.description: Public call to action — make it easy for others to participate.
missions.script: Want to help repeal Illinois' Digital Asset Tax but don't know where to start? It takes 2 minutes. Call your state rep's district office. Say: 'I support HB 5798 to repeal the Digital Asset Tax.' That's it. Find your rep: ilga.gov. #RepealDATA

missions.title: Attend any announced town halls
missions.description: Check your target legislators' websites and social media for upcoming town halls, office hours, or community events. If any are scheduled, attend and ask about HB 5798 during public comment.

missions.title: Follow-up email to noncommittal offices
missions.description: Send a follow-up email to any office that was noncommittal. Reference your earlier call/visit.

missions.title: Collect community testimony
missions.description: Reach out to 3+ people affected by the tax — OnionDAO attendees, local crypto meetup organizers, developers, educators. Ask them to write 2-3 sentences about how the tax affects them. Compile for future use.
